QUOTE: `mbedtls_memory_buffer_alloc_init()` (`:566-576`) calls `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free` itself, using a mutex-wrapped variant when `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` is on.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states the init function installs a mutex-wrapped calloc/free pair under MBEDTLS_THREADING_C. It doesn't say "plain otherwise" or "compile time", but both are implied by the conditional.
